scope: Formal untimed qualification of all 24 source-control contexts followed by source-matched observer-on/off candidate twins for all 17 S1 arms at the declared S2A anchors. No paired performance measurement, carrier winner, production migration or GEN-006 acceptance.

inputs.scenario_initialization: deterministic, no generator or randomized runtime input
inputs.primary_metric: per-tick wall clock steady_clock nanoseconds; process and per-tick samples, not replicates
inputs.quiet_expected: non-active after warmup; zero visits expected
inputs.active_expected: ongoing deterministic external maintenance after warmup; positive visits on >=90% measured ticks

run_order: literal contexts array order; no run reordering or post-hoc omissions

execution.collection_hard_stop: budget stop/incomplete, retain all processes and errors
preflight_required: match all S1 frozen native dependency sha256
record compiler executable sha256/version and linker version
hash binary and lock exact fixture bytes before any timed run
execution.developer_runs: separately marked and cannot qualify formal feasibility

quality_gates: reported scenario,side,workers,seed,horizons and actual stats match registration
nonquiet workloads remain active after warmup
quiet stays quiescent; zero-visit divisions forbidden
reactive workload observes a current-catalogue conversion
preserve inputs and results on any failure
fail unexecuted context; no skipped pass
RSS is whole-process peak, never added to per-World component bytes
measurement_limits: single source arm has no paired contrast and no storage winner
source-only feasibility timings cannot support final S2A/S2B conclusions
observer-on semantic twins and clear-time calibration are separate future gates
no unsupported worker participation proof from configured worker count
no cache, bandwidth, allocator-overhead or cross-platform causal claim
native elapsed clocks are host/noise dependent, do not carry production acceptance

future_primary.require: freeze all contrast source/binaries/scenarios/actual worker evidence, observer-off and observed twins, AB/BA order, warmup, per-invocation and total budgets before measurements

source_context_qualification.prerequisite: successful independent readback of every source context before candidate-twin execution

anchors.purpose: all E8 physical/capacity arms and source-vs-word S2A anchor
all E8/E16 within-representation S2A anchor plus source reference

requirements: both binaries derive from one immutable per-arm overlay and differ only by registered observer compile definition
observer-on proves actual candidate pool dispatch/background-worker execution where workers=4
observer-on and observer-off untimed runs match content hash, work arrays, input ledger, reactive ledger and declared semantic summary
binary, overlay, compiler, flags, fixture and registration hashes sealed before execution
independent reject-by-default readback validates all arms and both modes
no timing arrays may be emitted or interpreted

amendments: Registration v2 admits only full 24-context untimed source qualification and untimed 17-arm observer-on/off candidate twins. Paired S2A/S2B timing remains explicitly unadmitted.
